what_changed: Weekly digital-download counting tightened from 4 to 1 per customer per week in 2022
likely_effect_on_kpop: Reduces the repeat-purchase advantage that fandom-heavy acts including many K-pop releases could leverage
safe_wording: The available record supports a disproportionate effect on repeat-download-heavy fandom strategies, not a rule written specifically to target K-pop.

what_changed: Low-price floor introduced for album and EP sales counting in 2022
likely_effect_on_kpop: Reduces the usefulness of steeply discounted fan-purchase campaigns
safe_wording: This is better read as a broad anti-dumping or anti-manipulation adjustment that can hurt fandom-driven campaigns, rather than direct anti-K-pop proof.

what_changed: Hot 100 methodology excludes digital singles sales from direct-to-consumer sites
likely_effect_on_kpop: Weakens artist-store and fan-organized direct purchase channels that some fandoms use intensively
safe_wording: Billboard methodology excludes D2C digital singles from Hot 100 calculations; this weakens direct fan-purchase pathways but does not by itself show anti-K-pop intent.

what_changed: Global chart methodology weights official-only streams on subscription and ad-supported tiers plus download sales
likely_effect_on_kpop: Pushes chart success toward monetized platform activity measured inside Billboard-Luminate systems
safe_wording: The strongest reading is metric dependence: chart success depends on how a foreign-owned chart system weights monetized streams and official retailer sales.

what_changed: YouTube data will no longer be delivered to U.S. Billboard charts after 2026-01-16 amid a weighting dispute
likely_effect_on_kpop: Removes a major video-engagement input and highlights dependence on a foreign chart owner and foreign platform negotiating over formula
safe_wording: YouTube's own statement frames the issue as a disagreement over weighting and equal treatment of fans, which supports a metric-dependence reading more than an anti-K-pop one.

what_changed: Melon and FLO were added to the Luminate streaming-data panel for Republic of Korea during 2023
likely_effect_on_kpop: Improves inclusion of Korean domestic streaming data in Luminate-linked charts
safe_wording: This is counterevidence to a blanket anti-K-pop story: Korean domestic data were added, even though Billboard-Luminate still remain foreign-controlled scoreboards.
